rows.culsma_evidence: cultured_cells is introduced as the adherent cell input and reused for aspiration, washing, on-plate lysis, and crude-lysate transfer.
pbs is introduced for cell washing and later reused as the diluent in the reducing SDS-PAGE sample.
crude_lysate is collected after on-plate lysis and then passed to lysate_clarification.
clarified_lysate is reused in duplicate BCA sample wells and in the reducing sample preparation.
prepared_sample is mixed and heat-denatured before 25uL is loaded into the sample lane.
sample_lane is introduced during gel loading and reused in the stacking and separation field programs.
marker_lane is introduced during gel loading and reused in the stacking and separation field programs.
separated_gel collects the separated sample and marker lanes and is then reused in transfer-stack assembly.
transferred_membrane_tank carries the membrane through blocking, both antibody stages, wash stages, imaging, and protocol return.
tbst is introduced for pre-block and post-block washing and reused after both primary and secondary antibody incubation.

description: Tracked experimental objects are listed by introduction step and later use when identifier reuse is visible in step-anchored Culsma code.
